target.title: fix(outbound): report honest message delivery status
target.body:
Related: #84232

## What Problem This Solves

Best-effort direct channel sends could fail or partially fail while the message tool returned a success-shaped result. That prevented the existing source-reply safety path from recognizing an undelivered visible reply.

## Why This Change Was Made

The message-tool result now projects the durable sender's existing sent, suppressed, partial-failure, and failure states without changing throw behavior. Preparation also replaces the PR's duplicate serializer with one channel-message projection shared by command delivery and message-tool results. Internal command results retain hook diagnostics; model-facing message-tool JSON intentionally receives only the serializable subset.

## User Impact

Agents can distinguish delivered, suppressed, partially delivered, and failed best-effort sends. A dropped visible reply is no longer silently treated as delivered.

## Evidence

- Focused outbound, command-delivery, and source-reply suites: 57 tests passed.
- Touched-file formatting and diff checks passed.
- Fresh Codex autoreview: no findings, 0.97 confidence.
- Contributor's real Telegram platform-boundary proof reproduced a 401 failure that previously returned a success-shaped result.
- Exact prepared head: 8c04b7a93edbe444808306515c97c646f969221a; hosted CI is the merge gate.
